deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace leads a patient four-color deck built around planeswalkers, reimagined legendary characters, and Reality Fracture's academic themes. Develop your mana, keep cards flowing, and use Jace to refresh your creature-and-planeswalker board while removal contains opposing threats. Jace, Reality Sculptor is chief among the dedicated finishers, backed by Fblthp, Impossibly Lost, Sanctum Lurker, and larger creature threats. The deck gives up explosive starts and a dense answer package for thematic variety and a land-heavy foundation. Start the buy list with Jace, Reality Sculptor, Ajani Unrelenting, and Chandra, Chill of Compliance.

The quality model grades this deck below the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
